comparison.objective: Candidate breaks and collects HELICOIL tangs; record hoists a suspended bucket through a gin wheel and lands it on a scaffold deck.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precise bimanual mandrel-and-hammer manipulation; record uses sustained rope hauling, suspended-load control, bail guidance, and payout.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures with insert retention and complete fragment containment; record requires raising, drawing over the deck, landing, releasing, and stilling the bucket without carrying it or placing hands beneath it.
comparison.reason: Controlled hoisting of a large suspended load differs materially from localized impact fracture inside threaded inserts.
